patches.name: Uncensor patch (to buy)
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the self-extracting patch archive from the link below Run "Amairo Chocolate r18 DLC.sfx.exe" and select a folder to extract the patch installer into (the default folder should be fine) Run the extracted "Amairo Chocolate r18 DLC.exe" patch installer, select the game install f It's working if: When you go to get changed after being shown around the dorm, you walk in on someone else getting changed. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
